description: Parse a chord into root, quality, intervals, and (with a key) roman numeral + function. Numerals use the jazz convention by default (Cmaj7 in Am = ♭IIIΔ7); both jazz and classical numerals are always returned in `numerals`, and other valid readings in `alternatives`. Pass `scale` to read a minor key as harmonic or melodic minor.

convention.description: Which numeral convention fills `numeral`. Default: jazz.

scale.description: Scale to read the key in. Default: major, or natural minor with the harmonic-minor V for minor keys.

name: analyze_chord
